uploadAhm.title: Upload Incoming Plan AHM
uploadAhm.subtitle: Bulk upload AHM incoming plan from an Excel file (max {{max}} rows).
uploadAhm.hintUpload: Download the template, fill data starting at row 6, then upload here. Yellow columns are optional.
uploadAhm.summaryFixHint: Fix failed rows in the table (click a cell to edit), then submit again.

message.import: File does not match the template. Download the latest template and refill.
message.cellError: Some cells are still invalid — fix them in the table before submitting.
message.headerMismatch: Rows sharing a Delivery Note No have different header data (DN date, status, type, PO number, plant, gate, or supplier). Make them consistent before submitting.
message.parsed: {{count}} rows read and ready to process.
message.nothingToSubmit: Nothing to submit — all rows already succeeded. Edit a cell to mark a row for resubmission.
message.downloadFailed: Failed to download template. Retry or contact your administrator.
